# Known mypy diagnostics: path, message and code, with line numbers dropped so that
# unrelated edits do not change the list. Compared exactly by scripts/check_mypy_baseline.py
# (the "mypy" step of workflows/ci.yml): a diagnostic missing from this list fails the job,
# and so does an entry that mypy no longer reports. Remove an entry in the pull request that
# fixes it; `python scripts/check_mypy_baseline.py --update` rewrites the entries.
